items.alt: A hand-drawn editorial cartoon shows the Sensex tipping downward under Brent oil above $102, rising U.S. bond yields and foreign-investor selling.
A watercolor-and-ink tribute portrays Nana Patekar seated on a Goa terrace, surrounded by film reels, posters, awards and an empty director's chair.
A cartoon shows a delighted ChatGPT user beside GPT-6 signage and interactive chart, map and action panels marked Free plus Go.
A political cartoon shows Rahul and Priyanka Gandhi facing police barricades and a stack of three new FIR notices outside the Election Commission.
A graduate faces a proposed $70,000 OPT fee at a U.S. university checkpoint, with signs showing the later extension fee and comment period.
